title: Message/set edit of others' messages allowed
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 Message/set (new in 1e33ec7): edits of body/bodyType/mentions/broadcastMentions apply 'on a message where senderId is "self" and deletedAt is absent. The server MUST reject an edit of any other message with a forbidden SetError.' message.rs:698-1110 update path has no sender/deletedAt check for these fields; the edit applies and editedAt is injected (:766-770). Found by the 1e33ec7 audit (wf_af4656ea-dbb, both refuters upheld). Fix with a failing test quoting the draft; extend chat_client_wire.rs where the client exercises it.
notes: fix done in 5542091d: tests message_set_update_edit_rejects_other_sender, message_set_update_edit_rejects_deleted_message (chat-server integration), message_edit_after_delete_is_forbidden (testjig chat_client_wire)
close_reason: Fixed against jmap-chat-spec 1e33ec7; test-first, reviewed, gates green (stable/beta/1.88)
